reviews.comment: Greatly disliked this class. It was led by two profs and he was definitely the better one. The tests are essay questions and very convoluted. Class was confusing and a bore to sit through. He's not the worst and definitely a better pick than Marie Strader.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved taking him! Favorite prof ever! Ik the lectures are early but GO he's so engaging and kind. No textbook but do the supplementals and you'll do great on exams! Exams have lots of FRQ, an A is an 85, and your grade is mostly exams except for a project. Very doable A, interesting material and a caring prof! Go to office hours if you can!

This class is graded by 4 exams and a project. Make sure to read and complete the supplemental materials as they will boost your understanding of the class material! Dr. Pepper works hard to make sure you understand the material and provides excellent examples in class. Always come to lecture! You won't regret taking this class!

He is probably my favorite professor so far. YOU MUST GO TO CLASS. You have to be in class to understand his slides. Also, make sure to do all of the discussion questions that he posts. 70% of the tests were those exact questions. If you do not understand, GO TO OFFICE HOURS. He is SO helpful and will often give you answers for the test.

Dr. Pepper was one of the few professors I had that GENUINELY enjoys teaching the material. You NEED to go to class as there is no textbook to fill in any gaps. He is accessible outside of class with office hours. Do his supplemental material after lectures to do well on the exams!

Great prof and great guy. Very interesting and relevant lectures. Four exams with an hours project and he grades fairly. If you want to make an A, go to class, take good notes, do the supplemental questions, and go to office hours. Not the worst class ever but definitely one you need to study for.
Super interesting class, would definitely take hime again. Dont take this class if you dont go to class because it is very lecture heavy and the posted slides will not help you pass.

Dr. Pepper was a great professor and had many office hours that were extremely helpful for exams. To do good in the class, make sure to attend lectures to take notes and complete the review sheets. Overall, the material was manageable and he explained it well!

Dr. Pepper is a great professor. It's clear He truly cares about what he teaches. However, the reason I got a B in the class is because there were no homework assignments to buffer the exam grades. The class was 200 total points. 3 exams, a paper, and a final exam. Go to lecture and take really good notes to study. Review the supplementals as well!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were pretty cool, I liked the concepts a lot. I think thats ultimately the goal of every test, being able to connect all the concepts from lecture together for the short answer questions. Ultimately a really fun class and laid back professor.
Took him for the summer course, he had great lectures with very interesting topics. The tests had a free response section so you could explain yourself

I learned soooo much in this class, but it was very hard for me. I'm not an ecology/evolution person, so I had to work very hard and study a lot. On his tests he asks for details or list examples from lectures, so lots of memorization. He was generous with partial credit and exams were generally fair. His lectures were interesting and engaging
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had Dr. Pepper this semester, he was great. lectures were interesting, exams were straightforward, and there is no REQUIRED homework, but do the supplementals if you want to succeed in the class. He's amusing and super easy to talk to. There were 4 exams and 1 individualized project. GO TO CLASS!!!

Amazing professor who taught me so many interesting things! I didn't think I would enjoy this class as much as I did, but Dr. Pepper included so many real life examples that I found fascinating. Take good notes, he doesn't post the slides until after lecture. Do the supplementals and ask him about it in office hours - he is very willing to help.

BEST prof I have ever had. He come in last minute and took over our class when the original prof couldn't teach anymore. He taught me everything the original prof hadn't. My grade went from a C to an A under his teaching. Super caring, obviously loves his job. I would 100% take his class again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND

He stepped in when our other prof went to the hospital. He was amazing and really liked us asking questions. I wish I could have had him all year. Do his postlecture work and ask him about it in office hours. He won't release the answers.
Dr. Pepper was a fantastic professor! If you pay attention to the lectures, then you will be fine. Also doing the study guides/questions were very helpful for the exams.

I was nervous to have him bc some of the reviews weren't great, but I loved Dr. Pepper so much! His lectures were easy to follow & I learned info that I usually don't learn in other biology classes. He really cares about what he teaches and he always made sure we understood what he meant. Would definitely take a class from him again!

The best class I have ever taken at A&M. Dr. Pepper is genuinely excited to teach the subject, making his lectures easy to follow. Grading is based off exams and attendance. Exams mostly free response but he gives study guide questions to follow... DO THE STUDY GUIDE. No textbook but supplemental readings each day. Highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Pepper is my favorite professor I have had so far. He really made his class interesting and enjoyable, which in turn made it easy to study and learn. You must go to class and take good notes. He has office hours which are helpful if you go with questions! His tests are very similar to practice questions given. Easy end of semester project also!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You MUST go to class to pass. He lectures from memory and his powerpoint are useless if you didn't go to class. He is very entertaining to listen to and actually made me interested in the subject. He is VERY particular about the vocabulary you use when answering on exams (partial credit isn't really a thing). 10/10 recommend. Enjoyed the class!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Pepper was incredible for honors 214. Extremely easy, taught really fun information - not population math and crud like that, but about ants who grow parasitic fungi out of their heads and how COOL THAT IS. There is also a final project that is fun and made me learn a LOT, which, even a year later, still helps me in other classes. TAKE HIM!

I have no clue why Dr Pepper has such low reviews. I took him for 214 honors and it was easier, more fun, and I learned more than those in the regular sections. Ended up with a 98 in the class and didn't have to take the fourth test or the final! TAKE HIM!

I really enjoyed Dr. Pepper's class and I'm honestly shocked by all the negative reviews. He explained things very clearly and if you were confused on something, he was more than happy to clear things up. I would definitely take him again. His tests are fair, there is nothing on them out of left field. Overall I really enjoyed this class
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: His lectures are long and boring. There is no textbook, but he assigns readings and practice questions. The study questions show up on the exams so it's a good idea to go to his office hours and make sure the answers are right. The TA will give you all of the answers and tell you whats on the exam. Get comfortable with making interaction maps.

It is very DIFFICULT to prepare for any exam! He assigns anywhere between 6-20 homework questions (non-graded), and anywhere between 4-10 readings  per lecture. This would be okay, but he doesn't provide a key for the HW questions, so you don't know if they're even right!! 10 lectures per exam--you do the math. Find someone else, he's terrible.

He has a great way of teaching, but studying for his tests are a little tricky since there is no textbook and his lectures are based on current events. Great notes are essentially required. In my opinion if you are used to straight-forward notes from slides which you can study easily go with that professor.
Great Class! he teaches Molecular Biology as if he is telling a story. Makes it so interesting. You learn problem solving and experimentation all in one.
You must go to class! There is no book to go off of and do the study supplements! He gets the questions off of the study supplements.What helped me the most is going to the SI reviews

There is no book, so you have to come to every lecture to get the notes. Honestly this is one class you CAN'T miss, as the information is so detailed and so broad at times, you have to know what he's talking about and when if you want to do well. ALSO, do the supplemental reviews (go to SIs). 70's are B's and 85's are A's. Hard, but interesting!
